verses.text: The LORD rules! Let the earth celebrate! Let the many islands be glad!
Clouds and darkness surround him. His throne is built on what is right and fair.
Fire goes out ahead of him and burns up his enemies all around.
His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees it and trembles.
The mountains melt like wax in front of the LORD, in front of the Lord of all the earth.
The skies announce that he does what is right. All peoples see his glory.
Let all who worship idols be put to shame, all who boast about their worthless gods. All you gods, bow down to him!
Zion hears and is glad. The towns of Judah celebrate because of your judgments, LORD.
You, LORD, are the Most High over all the earth. You are far above all gods.
You who love the LORD, hate evil! He protects the lives of his faithful people. He rescues them from the power of the wicked.
Light shines on good people, and joy on those whose hearts are honest.
Be glad in the LORD, you who do what is right! Praise his holy name.
